data.title: 樱岛麻衣 · 黑丝微褪·足尖的大透视
data.description: 【成年 After Story · 樱岛麻衣 · 黑丝足尖】午后试装结束，二十岁以上成年后的麻衣独自斜倚在卧室床头。白衬衫前襟敞开，她把黑色连裤袜从一条腿缓慢卷到脚踝，另一条腿仍被薄纱完整包裹；褪袜的手指压出大腿勒痕，裸露足尖在前景微微蜷缩。她侧过脸露出女演员熟练又羞恼的目光——「看了这么久，总该学会哪一边更上镜了吧？」
data.action: 斜靠在柔软抱枕上，纤细手指轻轻褪下薄透黑丝至脚踝，足尖微微蜷缩，透出诱人的冷白肤色
data.lighting: 柔和午后窗光与暖色室内光，照亮精致足弓与足趾细腻反光
data.camera: close-up on feet, low angle foreshortening, bent knees, soft depth of field
data.promptProse: Afternoon light crosses adult, age-twenty-plus Mai Sakurajima reclining against a headboard. Her white blouse hangs open across bare breasts while both hands roll sheer black pantyhose down one thigh; the other leg remains wrapped for contrast. Pressure marks and a curled bare foot lead back to her composed violet gaze and reddened ears. Bedding and discarded wardrobe pieces create depth without a mirror or second figure. Medium horizontal fashion-intimacy portrait, no text.
data.nsfwProse: Resting back on soft pillows with her skirt hitched up and blouse open over bare breasts, Mai Sakurajima slowly peels sheer black pantyhose down her calves, averting her eyes with burning tsundere shame.
